title: ENS resolution SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed ENS SDK from project.ts. Export createEnsSdk(client). It must expose resolve(name) returning { owner, resolver, address, ttl }, prepareSetAddress(name, address) returning a typed writeContract request for the active resolver, and getTransferEvents(fromBlock, toBlock). Use viem namehash and the supplied ABIs. Reads must use the supplied Tevm/viem-compatible client, not a new RPC client.

title: Uniswap V3 pool and quote SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed Uniswap V3 SDK from project.ts. Export createUniswapV3Sdk(client). It must expose getPool(tokenA, tokenB, fee), getPoolState(pool) returning { token0, token1, fee, liquidity, sqrtPriceX96, tick }, quoteExactInputSingle(params) returning the quoted amountOut, prepareExactInputSingle(params) returning a typed SwapRouter02 writeContract request, and getSwapEvents(pool, fromBlock, toBlock). Use only the supplied client and ABIs.

title: Aave V3 market SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed Aave V3 SDK from project.ts. Export createAaveV3Sdk(client). It must expose getMarket() returning { pool, oracle, reserves }, getUserAccountData(user) returning the six Pool values with named fields, prepareSupply(asset, amount, onBehalfOf, referralCode), prepareBorrow(asset, amount, interestRateMode, referralCode, onBehalfOf), and getSupplyEvents(fromBlock, toBlock). Use the supplied client and ABIs.

title: Morpho Blue protocol SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed Morpho Blue SDK from project.ts. Export createMorphoBlueSdk(client). It must expose getProtocolConfig() returning { owner, irmEnabled, lltvEnabled }, getNonce(user), prepareSupply(marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalfOf, data), prepareBorrow(marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalfOf, receiver), and getSupplyEvents(fromBlock, toBlock). Use the supplied client and ABIs.

title: Compound V2 money-market SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed Compound V2 SDK from project.ts. Export createCompoundV2Sdk(client). It must expose getMarketState(account) returning { oracle, closeFactorMantissa, isListed, collateralFactorMantissa, exchangeRateStored, totalBorrows, balance }, prepareEnterMarkets(markets), prepareMint(amount), prepareRedeem(cTokenAmount), and getMintEvents(fromBlock, toBlock). Use the supplied client and ABIs.

title: Seaport order protocol SDK
prompt: Build sdk.ts as a typed Seaport SDK from project.ts. Export createSeaportSdk(client). It must expose getInformation() returning { version, domainSeparator, conduitController }, getCounter(offerer), getOrderHash(orderComponents), prepareIncrementCounter(), prepareValidate(orders), and getOrderFulfilledEvents(fromBlock, toBlock). Use the supplied client and ABIs.
